title: Fancy Candle Holder
body:
"A super fancy dyeable candle holder for holding only the most fancy candles."

Description

The Fancy Candle Holder (fancier version of the candle holder) can be bought at the Monstrous Manor or obtained from Halloween Poppers. Its light grey, smooth on the bottom, and generally more detailed then the regular candle holder. When a candle is placed above the holder it will combine with the item and lock onto it.

Trivia

As the description says, you can apply dye to the holder

despite the description, there are no fancy candles (they are all rather boring)

There was a glitch where the Fancy Candle Holder cost 🍬1,000,000 for a short while
